sentence: D'aven't earned your guybernation? The cave will know.

wombos.definition: A contraction of 'don't' and 'haven't,' used when you don't want to do a thing and also haven't done it. Captures procrastination and refusal in a single breath.
wombos.example: I d'aven't taken a shower since last Tuesday.

wombos.definition: A period of deliberate social and romantic withdrawal that a guy undergoes in order to improve himself — a masculine hibernation focused on personal growth.
wombos.example: He went into full guybernation for six months and came out a completely different person.
